title: Yellowed Crispy Spanish Salmon Skewers
description: A rich and energizing Spanish dish featuring salmon, grilled to perfection with a crispy exterior, Whole30-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is made with fresh salmon, olive oil, and spices, then grilled on a yakimono-grill for a crispy finish.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the salmon pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated salmon onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the salmon is cooked through and crispy on the outside.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
